text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT fired for service 'inference-prod' (svc_4321). Routing rule evaluated -> target: 'core-platform-oncall' but PD binding shows duplicate schedule entry for 'shadow-inference-ops' causing parallel fanout. Alert: high error-rate > 10% on /v1/generate.

maria: I just got a page and I'm not on the inference rotation. looks like contractors also got paged.

jamal: same, contractors got the alert too. this is noisy. is this the new PD automation push?

ashley: pinging @ops-automation, did the schedule sync job run recently?

ops-automation: the sync cron job ran at 2026-03-14T10:00Z and created a shadow schedule because metadata matched both 'inference-prod' and 'inference-legacy'. max_instances=2 -> duplicate binding applied.

alex-sre: confirming impact: user-facing requests degraded, 5xx spike across two regions starting 09:58Z. A subset of pages routed to wrong escalation policy.

maria: acked by me at 1961112230. I'm going to quiet the contractor group so they stop getting notifications.

maria: /pd disable escalation --service svc_4321 --target shadow-inference-ops  (note: using PD CLI)

incidental command output (ops):
```
$ pdcli service list-bindings svc_4321
- core-platform-oncall (escalation_policy: ep_900)
- shadow-inference-ops (escalation_policy: ep_901)  <-- duplicate, created 1961112200
```

jamal: I can stop the duplicate by removing the shadow binding, but we should not delete until we confirm the correct target is intact.

ashley: I'll reassign the immediate pager routing to core-platform-oncall as a fallback.

alex-sre: running hotfix: pdcli binding remove --service svc_4321 --binding shadow-inference-ops --by "oncall-hotfix"

ops-automation: Received request, aborting next sync cycle. Will block auto-recreate for 1 hour.

incident-bot: Page update: removed binding shadow-inference-ops from svc_4321 at 1961112255. Fanning reduced.

maria: test page to confirm only the proper rotation receives it.

ashley: firing manual test alert now.

incident-bot: TEST PAGE (manual) for svc_4321 now fired -> routed to core-platform-oncall. ack pending.

jamal: acked at 1961112270. only the correct rotation received the test.

maria: rolling the oncall handoff: jamal -> ashley for remainder of shift.

oncall-bot: On-call handoff scheduled: jamal handing to ashley at 11:00 local.

alex-sre: technical mitigation notes: root cause = sync job pattern match too greedy when parsing team labels ('inference-*' matched both prod and legacy). Remediation: tighten regex, add explicit exclude for legacy schedules. Also add safety check to prevent multiple bindings on single PD service.

ops-automation: patch merged to syncer with config change `--team-pattern "^inference-prod$"` and a guard `--max-bindings-per-service=1`. Deploying now to staging, will roll to prod after 30m smoke.

maria: customer impact: brief 5–7 minute increase in 5xx for some customers in eu-west-1 and us-west-2. No data exfiltration. Support notify in #support: "short outage affecting text-generation calls; auto-retries may have caused increased latency".

ashley: creating incident ticket and assigning postmortem. I'll capture timelines and PD audit log.

alex-sre: logging snippet for timeline:
```
09:58:12Z - error rate spike begins
09:59:03Z - incident-bot alert fired (duplicate binding caused extra escalation)
10:01:20Z - duplicate binding identified
10:03:15Z - shadow binding removed
10:05:00Z - test page routed correctly
10:10:00Z - error rate back to baseline
```

jamal: any followups before we close the thread? if ops-automation is patching syncer we should add a regression test that simulates label collisions.

ops-automation: will add unit test and an integration test that runs against a mocked PD api. schedule: CI change + test by tomorrow EOD.

maria: ok great. I'll update support and send a short RCA to stakeholders: root cause, remediation, and prevention.

incident-bot: Incident updated: severity -> S2, status -> mitigated, linked PD incident pd_inc_9876.

ashley: thanks everyone. follow-up actions assigned in the ticket. closing thread once postmortem draft is in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
